matches.rationale: Both arm changes and incremental contrast are selected; observed pairs and attrition limits are explicit.
The opening story pairs supported awareness with both unestablished downstream effects; no equivalence claim.
Selective follow-up, baseline composition and endpoint-specific completeness are distinguished; fixed weights do not recover missing outcomes.
Receipt and recall comparisons retain pre-existing gaps and are explicitly noncausal, distinct from assignment.
Crossover and log/recall discordance are explicit; neither measure is treated as attention or assignment.
Need intensity is separated from prespecified heterogeneous response; intervals and adjusted interaction tests qualify targeting.
Selected-recaller diagnostics and routed user experience are both selected in the same beat, with correlation and causal limitations.
Complementary user-experience component credited jointly on F7; not duplicate full coverage.
Bounded recommendation for further controlled learning; no sales, ROI, broad rollout or tiny-cell effectiveness claim.
